# Willow Vibes

> All-in-one wellness app: guided meditation, sleep stories, breathwork, AI coaching, mood tracking, and SOS relief — designed to calm the nervous system and build lasting daily practice.

Willow Vibes is a premium meditation and mental wellness platform with a 30-day foundation course, science-backed somatic programs (e.g. Vagus Nerve Reset), and adaptive AI tools. Billing runs through Paddle (Merchant of Record); plans include monthly, yearly, and a one-time Founders Lifetime.

- [Pricing](/pricing): Plus monthly, yearly, and Founders Lifetime plans with 7-day free trial.
- [About](/about): Mission, team, and philosophy behind Willow Vibes.
